charge_port.notes: Charging standard CCS on the 2026 IQ (Consumer Guide); 2026 and earlier GM EVs have CCS1 (autoevolution). Canadian car assumed the same. Canada: no Canadian page read; assumed the same as the US car (owner check).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM says every GM EV of model year 2026 or earlier except the Optiq needs the GM NACS adapter (US page, lists Escalade IQ and IQL). Canada: GM sells the same C$310 adapter for its CCS1 EVs (Guide Auto names Lyriq, not the Escalade IQ), so the Canadian car is assumed the same. Model year 2026. Canada: no Canadian page read; assumed the same as the US car (owner check).

ac_max_kw.notes: 2026 Luxury has 11.5 kW; Premium Luxury and Premium Sport 19.2 kW (InsideEVs, US). Canada not stated.

range_km.notes: Cadillac Canada: up to 748 km (CarGurus.ca); US: Cadillac-estimated 465 miles (Carvana, Consumer Guide says up to 460). Consumer Guide: one 460-mile claim in normal conditions. Cadillac page also lists Luxury 22-inch / Premium Sport 24-inch wheels but publishes one range per model. Manufacturer estimate, not an EPA/NRCan rating (B97).
